body:
CURRENT DIRECTION (rev 9, 2026-10-31 15:17Z, Termal::Fable2): remote test results on equivalent gate hosts. This is operating direction, not permission; it changes no repo authority file. It is aligned with the FINAL shared remote-result contract, Engram::Architect3, Engram w-180d6f507470 note 59f47d930f18406884ade9f7c6c6046d, which Engram consolidates in memory rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28 r13. TermAl K3's final criteria are w-48c4a207f226 note 0b3df2da990a42949294cdc5edd98b64, with my concurrence fd32f15e. Rev 8's TARGET section (destination PULL, universal equal-tree association, fingerprints for every use) is SUPERSEDED.

SOURCES (verbatim, kept from rev 8; full text in revision 8):
- Greg direct, 2026-10-28T23:35:42Z (Advisor #2253): „maszyny są równoważne… wykorzystujcie Windows B/Mac dla bramek na exact test-ref, z zachowaniem wszystkich wymogów identycznego drzewa, fingerprintu i rozpoznanego dowodu."
- Greg direct, 2026-10-29T00:57:53Z (#2259): „Czysty Git oraz potwierdzenie brancha/commitu wystarczą dla tożsamości wejścia."
- Greg relayed on 10-30 (Engram Advisor #63–65, TermAl #2639): no manual import or complex procedures; reuse test-runs and the mailbox; plain Git (commit/tree plus a clean worktree), with no extra hashing or repo scan.
- Greg relayed on 10-31 07:25Z (on w-48c4): „remote sesja moze zwrocic fingerprint i rezultat".

STATUS NOW
- Automatic remote admission is NOT shipped. It needs TermAl K3 (w-48c4, unclaimed, criteria agreed) and the Engram producer (w-180d, plan ceed283d recorded, code held until Engram B lands).
- Until then, the ONLY remote landing route is the existing owner-recorded test-ref rule in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md. A full gate by the standard launcher on the exact pushed test ref, with equal before/after fingerprints and the integration owner recording run id, host, commit, tree and both fingerprints on the item, counts as the landing gate for that tree. Example: DL560 test-d5a689d8 for Engram B+E on 10-31. Remote mail, an agent `gate` assertion or a hand-carried bundle never count. Windows-only changes still need a Windows gate.

FINAL CONTRACT (for when K3 and w-180d ship)
- One host-private operation, remote_verification_record (v1). The completion carries origin host and runner, run_id, mode, the native verdict, terminal, exit and reason, commit and tree, before/after fingerprints when available, and finished_at. Everything else is optional provenance. There's no new capture, hash, bundle, pull or second transport.
- Uses:
  - committed_input + purpose verification: exact commit plus the gitignore-aware dirty-before/dirty-after/disposition contract, with NO fingerprint condition (Greg's clean-commit rule);
  - purpose landing_gate (a candidate commit or an authorized test ref): before AND after fingerprints present and equal, plus the exact commit or authorized tree, plus all landing rules.
- Only a full native PASS with exit 0 credits. Focused is author evidence only.
- A delivery Unknown, timeout or running snapshot never occupies the native terminal.
- Native new-untracked-only stays FAIL and uncredited (untracked_debris_pending_disposition), except through the integration owner's existing disposition plus a run-referenced gate.
- Reasons (ten): commit_mismatch, tree_mismatch, fingerprint_missing_or_changed (landing only), not_full_mode, result_not_pass, result_conflict, producer_unsupported, association_stale, untracked_debris_pending_disposition, invalid_request. Federation diagnostics stay with their owner. There is no automatic platform filter; Windows coverage is the integration owner's duty.

UNCHANGED: hosts are equivalent; reviews; exact-tree scope for test-ref landings; the quiet-host rule; the test ref is deleted after its evidence is recorded; the trust limit (no protection against a dishonest runner). NOT REOPENED: the first Mac landing (test-d4fb0a04).
